review.summary: 1 finding: a critical null-safety bug in the new `created_at` field mapping.

findings.title: Potential null pointer exception when mapping `createdAt` to ISO string
findings.rationale: `row.createdAt` is used without a null check. If the database column `created_at` is nullable (e.g., due to a schema migration or a bug), calling `.toISOString()` on `null` will throw a runtime error. The contract marks `created_at` as optional, but the code always includes it, creating a mismatch that can cause crashes in production.
